# Olve.Pipelines

> A small GitOps CD orchestration service for a homelab (v2). You bind a pipeline to your Git
> repository; the pipeline is defined in TypeScript in `.pipelines/pipeline.ts` (typed models,
> steps, handlers, sequential stages of parallel steps, `when` blocks, push/poll/webhook triggers). On each
> commit the service compiles the definition in a sandboxed Job into a new version, and runs each
> step as a Kubernetes Job. You drive binding, secrets and operations (trigger, rerun, continue,
> cancel, blocking steps, version switch) with the `pl` CLI or the web UI.

All documentation pages below are served as raw Markdown at the listed URLs. Fetch them
directly (no auth, no repo clone needed) and parse the raw text.

## Docs

- [Setup Guide index](/docs/index.md): What the service does, the v2 concepts (model, step, handler, stage, version, run, attempt), the GitOps model and a minimal example.
- [Getting Started](/docs/getting-started.md): Put a repo under CD: `.pipelines/` layout, local check, `pl binding create`, secrets, first run.
- [Pipeline Reference](/docs/pipeline-reference.md): Models, secrets, steps, library steps, reusable steps, handlers, stages, mappers, `when`, triggers, `onFailure`, the checks that reject a pipeline, versioning.
- [Local Development](/docs/local-development.md): `pl dev describe | validate | run | pipeline`, running a step in its real image, the local pool.
- [Pipeline Config](/docs/configuration.md): Typed per-instance config (`config(…)`, `secretRef`, `ctx.config`), the YAML document and its snapshots, pending versions until config is satisfied, runs pinning config, defaults, `pl config get|set|history|rollback|check`.
- [Binding, Reconcile & Versions](/docs/binding-and-reconcile.md): The binding, how changes are noticed (poll + webhook), how a commit becomes a version, switch and rollback, reading the status.
- [Runs & Operations](/docs/runs-and-operations.md): Runs, attempts, supersede, de-duplication, rerun/continue/cancel, outputs and files, how a step runs, storage, retention.
- [The pl CLI](/docs/cli.md): Installing `pl`, profiles and login, every command.
- [API Reference](/docs/api-reference.md): Every HTTP endpoint and schema (generated from the OpenAPI document), auth, the error model, the live event stream.
- [Running an Instance](/docs/self-hosting.md): Server configuration keys, logging, a throwaway local instance with Docker Compose, letting it deploy itself.
- [Deploying to Docker Compose](/docs/compose-deploy.md): The compose deployer (pull, recreate, health, rollback; its env and API), `deployTarget()` with `kind: compose | none`, `steps.composeDeploy`.
- [Blocking Steps](/docs/blocking-steps.md): Holding a pipeline's runs at a step while working on the pipeline or its target, and resuming them.
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting.md): Symptoms → causes → fixes.

## Reference

- [Subject Index](/docs/subjects.md): Maps topics to the exact page and anchor.
